title: Manufacturing Engineering Technician III - Second Shift - Bryan Dairy

cond_0001.intro:
Provide lead equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of three to five years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum three years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Demonstrated hands-on experience in the required process
Advanced knowledge in the area being assigned
Understanding of DFM/A, FMEA and IPC requirements
Able to write technical reports for the site
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
Knowledge of Basic Statistics and carrying a DOE
Relentless in exploring new and latest methods in improving assembly techniques
Lead Process and Equipment Evaluation aligned to the needs of the site as assigned by the ME Manager
Or equivalent combination of education and experience

This role requires hands-on manufacturing knowledge with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering, and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0242.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups.
Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality based on direct observation of machine and line performance.
Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data and other available sources continuously to track and gauge machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Determine when machine repairs are needed and execute out-of-cycle maintenance.
Perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Execute initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and carry out repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and direct assistance as needed to accomplish repairs.
Train and direct Machine Operators on assigned line(s) on an ongoing basis.
Lead machine operation to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency.
Serve as the front-line person accountable for ensuring assigned line(s) performs at maximum efficiency and product quality; interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine and drive corrective actions.
Deliver training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Drive optimum process performance by measuring and optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste in support of Manufacturing Engineers.
Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Deliver daily pass-down reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of three to five years of related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum three years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Understanding of DFM/A, FMEA and IPC requirements
Ability to write technical reports for the site
Or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
Advanced knowledge in the assigned process area
Knowledge of basic statistics and experience carrying out a DOE
Familiarity with exploring new methods for improving assembly techniques
Experience leading process and equipment evaluation aligned to site needs
cond_0242.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

cond_0457.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician III to provide lead equipment and process support, including machine maintenance, to printed circuit assembly lines. The role requires manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering, and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0457.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups.
Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Observe machine and line performance and determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Determine when machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance.
Perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within skill level.
Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and provide assistance as needed to complete repairs.
Support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) through targeted training and direction.
Assist with machine operation to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or improve line efficiency.
Coordinate with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions, and ensure assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Support Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Prepare daily pass-down reports and share them with the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0457.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of three to five years of related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering, and/or training
Minimum three years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Understanding of DFM/A, FMEA, and IPC requirements
Ability to write technical reports
Demonstrated hands-on experience in the required process
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
Advanced knowledge in the area being assigned
Knowledge of basic statistics and experience carrying out a DOE
Familiarity with exploring new methods for improving assembly techniques
Experience leading process and equipment evaluation aligned to site needs

This role owns lead equipment and process support — including machine maintenance — for printed circuit assembly lines. You will bring manufacturing knowledge and hands-on experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering, and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0467.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups.
Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance.
Execute 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level.
Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and direct assistance as needed to accomplish repairs.
Lead ongoing training and direction for Machine Operators on assigned line(s).
Drive changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency through direct machine operation.
Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and take ownership as the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality.
Deliver training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Drive optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0467.requirements:
Demonstrated hands-on experience in the required process.
Advanced knowledge in the area that is being assigned.
Relentless in exploring new and latest methods in improving assembly techniques.
Lead Process and Equipment Evaluation aligned to the needs of Site as assigned by the ME Manager.
Knowledge in Basic Statistics and knowledge of carrying a DOE is a plus.
Understanding of DFM/A, FMEA and IPC requirements.
Able to write technical reports for the Site.
Associate's degree highly preferred.
Minimum of three to five years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training.
Minimum three years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines.
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Work with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Monitor machine and line performance alongside line staff and coordinate the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Continuously monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data and other available sources to track and gauge machine and process performance together with the broader team.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).

Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Work alongside Manufacturing Engineers to achieve optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Share recommendations for designing, fabricating and/or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Provide daily pass-down reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0578.intro:
Provide lead equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0578.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0597.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups.
Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance.
Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level.
Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs.
Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction.
Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency.
Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality.
Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0597.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around three to five years of experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or relevant training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around three years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines.
Hands-on experience in the required process.
Working knowledge of DFM/A, FMEA and IPC requirements.
Ability to write technical reports.
Preferred Requirements
Background in advanced knowledge of the assigned process area.
Openness to exploring new methods for improving assembly techniques.
Familiarity with Basic Statistics; exposure to carrying out a DOE is a plus.
Experience leading process and equipment evaluations aligned to site needs.
